about: The field of a place at resolution N holds every bound placed at the place or at none (placedAt), each in the state its poles give: interval poles that do not meet conflict, as two signers on one key do; a value read outside them is forbidden; a bound nothing read, a reader that refused and a demand unpaid are required; the rest is free. Each coordinate cut to its first N steps takes the worst state it holds. It reads the region summaries and the landed readings of one fold, and no reader runs.
